listing.name: SSX 3 (PlayStation 2) (SSX 3 native Rust port)
listing.summary: Attach an existing Windows SSX 3 Rust player prepared from your own USA PS2 disc through the upstream source route. Keep its original project/data paths, memory card and settings; private bundled games and managed replacement are separate.

steps.title: Prepare the supported PS2 source locally
steps.instruction: Use your own SSX 3 USA PS2 disc image for SLUS_207.72. Upstream documents tools/setup.py followed by cargo run --profile game -p ssx3; complete that preparation independently before attachment. The selected source does not publish a whole-disc digest here, so a filename or serial alone is not cryptographic verification. Other regions, the Xbox Berti port and other SSX games are separate source contracts.

steps.title: Keep the existing completed Windows build together
steps.instruction: Use the completed windowed target/game/ssx3.exe in its existing prepared project. Keep the source tree, orig/SLUS_207.72, generated code and your original SSX 3 (USA).iso at their active locations. The native file reader and boot path use the build-time project root or existing SSX3_ISO/SSX3_DATA_DIR overrides; moving the executable alone does not relocate those inputs. Project MIT terms do not grant rights to the original game.

steps.title: Attach the windowed native player
steps.instruction: Select the completed target/game/ssx3.exe, set working directory to its existing project root and leave arguments empty. Review that exact intent and request Play separately. This entry boots the game and runs its window/event loop in the same process. Do not select ssx3-headless.exe, Cargo, a setup/compiler script, an event-skipping diagnostic or another platform build as the player.

steps.title: Preserve the active card and settings roots
steps.instruction: For the ordinary project-built route, retain saves/ssx3-mc0.ps2 and saves/ssx3-settings.cfg under the existing working directory, together with all backups and any existing SSX3_MEMCARD/SSX3_SETTINGS overrides. Upstream’s optional private standalone pack selects a different default Windows root, Roaming AppData/SSX3, unless overridden. Do not mix those roots, replace a populated card or assume emulator/card/state compatibility. Keep original images, extracted data, generated outputs and texture/customization inputs private and intact.

steps.title: Keep preparation and replacement upstream
steps.instruction: Upstream owns source updates, regeneration and compatibility decisions. Its optional bundle.py embeds original game data and is documented for personal use only; do not upload or share that private bundle. Complete changes outside a running game and review/relink the resulting player. Windows gameplay/controller behavior and real-save recovery remain unobserved here. Registration provides no managed installation, update, backup, rollback, migration or external-file deletion.

warnings: Use the completed windowed ssx3.exe and its existing project root. Preserve both the ordinary saves/ root and any separately used standalone AppData/SSX3 root; private game-containing bundles must not be shared.
